description: Authorise this MCP server against the user's AutoWhisper account. Returns a link; the user clicks Approve once and this server is authorised immediately — no restart, nothing to copy and paste. Call this when a tool reports it is not connected, or when a call returns Unauthorized. Show the user the link and tell them you are waiting.

device_name.description: What the user will see on the approval screen, e.g. 'Claude Desktop'. Name yourself so they recognise the request.

name: autowhisper_connect
title: Connect this agent to AutoWhisper
